title: Design System: 港股證據研究室

display.purpose: Article and index headings; 28px on compact screens.

title.purpose: 20px sans-serif card title preceding category metadata.

body.purpose: Controls and summaries; article summaries use 1.8 leading.

label.purpose: Readable supporting information, distinct from a subject title.

shadows.name: flat-surface
shadows.purpose: Finance override for ordinary cards, panels and reading surfaces.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Shared button state transitions and contents chevron.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared primary action. Its source retains a legacy colored shadow; that shadow is not new elevation guidance.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg,#ffffff),0 0 0 4px var(--primary,#185bd1)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-primary:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}.ds-primary{background:var(--primary,#185bd1);color:var(--surface,#ffffff);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,118,110,.18)}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--primary-strong,#164da8)}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Outlined parallel action with a clear focus ring.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg,#ffffff),0 0 0 4px var(--primary,#185bd1)}.ds-secondary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-secondary:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}}.ds-secondary{border:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec);background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#13243a)}.ds-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--primary,#185bd1);color:var(--primary-strong,#164da8)}

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Quiet reset or secondary control within a filter area.
components.css: .ds-ghost{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-ghost:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg,#ffffff),0 0 0 4px var(--primary,#185bd1)}.ds-ghost:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-ghost:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-ghost{transition:none}}.ds-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#536174)}.ds-ghost:hover{background:var(--surface-soft,#f5f7fa);color:var(--ink,#13243a)}

components.name: Warning button
components.description: Retained semantic warning variant, not a decorative call to action.
components.css: .ds-warning{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-warning:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg,#ffffff),0 0 0 4px var(--primary,#185bd1)}.ds-warning:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-warning:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-warning{transition:none}}.ds-warning{background:var(--accent,#b45309);color:var(--surface,#ffffff)}.ds-warning:hover{background:#b45309}

components.name: Reading input
components.description: Visible label, clear boundary and a comfortable search field.
components.html: <label class="ds-field" for="ds-search">搜尋文章<input id="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="例如：RSI、倉位、重繪、港股…"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:.55rem;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink,#13243a)}.ds-field input{width:100%;min-height:46px;border:1px solid var(--field-border,#a9b8ca);border-radius:7px;padding:.7rem .85rem;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ink,#13243a);caret-color:var(--primary,#185bd1)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#647186;opacity:1}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#3479eb);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Navy navigation
components.description: Principal navigation uses light text on navy and a distinct current-page surface.
components.html: 學習指標百科研究札記工具
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;padding:16px;background:var(--navy,#10263f);font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);}.ds-nav a{display:inline-flex;min-height:2.65rem;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 13px;color:#dfe8f4;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.65;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"],.ds-nav a:focus-visible{background:var(--navy-active,#233e5f);color:#ffffff}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#185bd1);outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-nav a{padding:9px;font-size:14px}}

components.name: Category route
components.description: A category route with a pale selected state; live pages append actual counts.
components.css: .ds-topic{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:.6rem .9rem;border:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec);border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#13243a);font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none}.ds-topic:hover,.ds-topic[aria-current]{background:#eaf1fd;color:var(--primary-strong,#164da8);border-color:#b9cdee}.ds-topic:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#3479eb);outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-topic{gap:14px;font-size:14px;min-height:42px;padding:8px 12px}}

components.name: Illustrated article card
components.description: Structural preview with placeholder copy; production values and diagrams come from each article record.
components.html:

閱讀時間更新日期
components.css: .ds-article{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#13243a);overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);}.ds-article:hover{border-color:var(--field-border,#a9b8ca)}.ds-preview{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec);background:#f1f5f8}.ds-preview svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);}.ds-article-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;padding:20px 22px 17px}.ds-article h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 10px}.ds-article a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-article a:hover{color:var(--primary-strong,#164da8)}.ds-article a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#3479eb);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-category{color:var(--primary-strong,#164da8);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:7px}.ds-article p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted,#536174);margin:0 0 19px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:3;overflow:hidden}.ds-article-footer{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-top:auto;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec);font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted,#536174);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-article-footer svg{margin-left:auto;color:var(--primary,#185bd1)}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-article-body{padding:18px}}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-article-body{padding:19px}}

components.name: Evidence Pipeline
components.description: Subject-specific ordered teaching sequence; the current homepage does not mount it.
components.css: .ds-evidence{margin:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface-soft,#f5f7fa);color:var(--ink,#13243a);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:21px;box-shadow:none;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);line-height:1.65}.ds-evidence figcaption{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .16);padding-bottom:12px}.ds-evidence figcaption strong{font-size:17px;text-align:right}.ds-evidence ol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px 24px;list-style:none;margin:14px 0 0;padding:0}.ds-evidence li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;padding:12px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec)}.ds-evidence li>span{font-family:var(--font-mono,"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",Menlo,monospace);font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:var(--primary-strong,#164da8)}.ds-evidence li div{display:grid}.ds-evidence li strong{font-size:15px}.ds-evidence small{color:var(--muted,#536174);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-evidence{padding:17px}.ds-evidence ol{gap:10px 18px}}@media(max-width:560px){.ds-evidence figcaption{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.ds-evidence figcaption strong{text-align:left}}

components.css: .ds-contents{max-width:240px;padding:0 0 0 22px;border-left:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec);color:var(--ink,#13243a);font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:14px}.ds-contents button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:36px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink,#13243a);font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK","PingFang HK","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:650;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-contents button svg{transform:rotate(180deg);transition:transform .15s ease-out}.ds-contents ol{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:14px 0 20px}.ds-contents li{line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:12px}.ds-contents a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-contents a:hover{color:var(--primary-strong,#164da8);text-decoration:underline}.ds-contents div>a{color:var(--primary-strong,#164da8)}.ds-contents a:focus-visible,.ds-contents button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#3479eb);outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:999px){.ds-contents{max-width:none;border:1px solid var(--line,#dfe5ec);background:var(--surface-soft,#f5f7fa);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 16px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-contents button svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A practical Hong Kong financial reference library: white reading surfaces, light-gray grouping, navy navigation and restrained blue controls. Self-hosted Chinese sans-serif type supports scanning, comparison and sustained study. Borders, alignment and informative illustrations carry the visual identity.

The approved reference world draws on TradingView indicator cards, StockCharts ChartSchool reading structure and Futu Chinese article cards. The prior purple museum-journal direction, serif display voice and architecture cover are rejected. The replacement changes presentation while preserving the 100 articles, 82 indicator records, 200 teaching figures, historical examples and calculation behavior.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces and light-gray groups with a navy navigation frame.
Self-hosted Lab Sans / Noto Sans HK across headings, reading and controls.
Illustrated article cards with the title before category and reading metadata.
A bounded reading column with a right-hand contents rail that collapses on smaller screens.
Real sources, explicit limitations and functional educational tools.

rules.name: The Meaningful Color Rule
rules.body: Color supports written labels and state; it never establishes review, reliability or risk on its own.

rules.name: The Title First Rule
rules.body: Lead cards with their subject title. Put category and reading metadata beneath it; use numbers only when their order teaches something.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep sustained prose within the reading measure while allowing libraries, comparisons and tools to use the wider site shell.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Separate reading surfaces with spacing, borders and light-gray grouping. Reserve a diffuse shadow for the expanded navigation overlay; do not turn every paragraph into a raised card.

dos: **Do** use the white, light-gray, navy and blue palette with the documented Lab Sans roles.
**Do** preserve real article metadata, indicator filters, query parameters, source links and calculation behavior.
**Do** keep the article title before its category; use each article's own diagram data for its thumbnail.
**Do** keep numbered diagram markers visibly separate from their labels and preserve full figures in the article.
**Do** provide clear focus states, meaningful figure descriptions, mobile wrapping and reduced-motion support.
**Do** preserve the distinction between historical observations, teaching examples, assumptions and review status.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce the rejected purple/serif museum-journal world or architecture hero.
**Don't** replace explanatory thumbnails with fabricated market feeds, returns or unrelated decoration.
**Don't** infer author credentials, completed review or investment suitability from a badge or component.
**Don't** add decorative eyebrows or section numbers that do not convey subject or sequence.
**Don't** promote inherited styling defects or unimported archival CSS into the shipping design system.
